open_points.subject: agent identity after configuration reload
open_points.text: “names are unique in an installation, and a configuration repeating one is refused at start” conflicts with “Exactly three checks apply to a re-read: the file can be read and parsed; every token is at least 43 characters; no two tokens are equal.”
open_points.question: When the changed token list contains two agents with the same name but distinct valid tokens, must the re-read reject the list or accept two indistinguishable agent actors?
options: Reject the re-read when agent names repeat
Accept repeated agent names after start
Assign a different actor identity independent of agent_name
open_points.default_guess: Reject the re-read when agent names repeat.

open_points.subject: file inputs to read operation nodes
open_points.text: “JSON values as capability:canonical_values.canonical_bytes, naming the first failure.”
open_points.question: For a read operation with a file input, which module reads the SpooledFile bytes and through which capability are those bytes supplied to service_invoker.prepare_request?
options: runs reads them and passes the bytes to effects
open_points.default_guess: effects reads them through store.read_value_bytes and passes them to service_invoker.

open_points.subject: service file-output spool refusal
open_points.text: “Send outcomes operation_refused, operation_failed (3xx), contract_violation: named by module:service_invoker, recorded by module:effects.”
open_points.question: Who produces contract_violation when a valid 2xx file response is rejected by store.spool_file because a file or run spool ceiling is exceeded, given that service_invoker does not see the run spool?
options: effects maps the store spool refusal to contract_violation and records the non-read attempt as applied
service_invoker must receive spool state and produce the outcome
the spool refusal becomes internal_error instead of contract_violation
open_points.default_guess: effects maps the spool refusal to contract_violation; for a non-read operation the EffectAttempt is applied.

open_points.subject: failure during startup recovery
open_points.text: “Every record is written through module:store, one call and one transaction (K-17).” The stated store-failure outcome is that “the request is answered as an internal error,” but recover_in_flight_attempts and recover_running_runs execute before any request or open surface.
open_points.question: What happens if a store read, record change, or spool removal fails during startup recovery?
options: Abort startup with the surface closed and retry recovery on the next start
Continue startup with the affected run unchanged
Skip the affected record and recover the remaining runs
open_points.default_guess: Abort startup with the surface closed and retry recovery on the next start.

open_points.subject: meaning of no partial start
open_points.text: “The surface never opens; there is no partial start.” conflicts with recovery steps that persist EffectAttempt, NodeExecution, approval, waiting-point and run-status changes before a later recovery step can fail.
open_points.question: Does “no partial start” mean only that the MCP surface is never opened, or must all recovery writes be rolled back if any later startup step fails?
options: Only publication of the surface is all-or-nothing; completed recovery writes remain
All recovery mutations across every run must be rolled back
Recovery writes remain only through a specified checkpoint
open_points.default_guess: Only publication of the surface is all-or-nothing; completed recovery writes remain.
